response.justification: The candidate fails to meet a critical minimum qualification: 8 years of C++ programming experience (resume documents only ~6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015). While they demonstrate strong infrastructure, distributed systems, and technical leadership capabilities, these assets cannot overcome the fundamental technology gap for a C++-centric cloud compute platform role requiring deep systems-level expertise.
strengths: Proven large-scale distributed systems expertise handling millions of HTTP requests/second and microservices architecture at Dunnhumby
Demonstrated technical leadership through current Staff Engineer role, workshops, and recurring mentoring initiatives with strong emphasis on engineering best practices
Polyglot engineer with deep software craftsmanship skills in TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and architectural patterns
concerns: Critical gap: Only ~6 months documented C++ experience versus required 8-year minimum qualification for this role
Limited production-scale cloud compute platform expertise; cloud exposure restricted to AWS CDK at one company, lacking depth in compute technologies and hardware architecture
Technical leadership experience appears primarily mentoring-focused rather than strategic ownership of large-scale infrastructure initiatives
